source_text: It’s Madalyn!

structure.raw_value: BrShOpNo1#.It’s Madalyn!
structure.script_literal: "BrShOpNo1#.It’s Madalyn!"

translation: To Madalyn!

source_text: Lillian is with her.

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Lillian is with her.
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Lillian is with her."

translation: Lillian jest z nią.

source_text: She’s loving every minute of it!

structure.raw_value: D2EcAg@.She’s loving every minute of it!
structure.script_literal: "D2EcAg@.She’s loving every minute of it!"

translation: Czerpie z tego każdą chwilę przyjemności!

source_text: You can’t resist our charm.

structure.raw_value: D3FlOp>.You can’t resist our charm.
structure.script_literal: "D3FlOp>.You can’t resist our charm."

translation: Nie oprzesz się naszemu urokowi.

source_text: She wants more… Give her more.

structure.raw_value: MlFlDe.She wants more… Give her more.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlDe.She wants more… Give her more."

translation: Chce więcej… Dajcie jej więcej.

source_text: I told you, Mother. It’s the females of the species that are worth saving.

structure.raw_value: MlFlOp.I told you, Mother. It’s the females of the species that are worth saving.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlOp.I told you, Mother. It’s the females of the species that are worth saving."

translation: Mówiłem ci, Matko. To samice naszego gatunku warto ratować.

source_text: We have to do something.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl#>.We have to do something.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl#>.We have to do something."

translation: Musimy coś zrobić.

source_text: Get ’em, Dad!

structure.raw_value: TaMaAg.Get ’em, Dad!
structure.script_literal: "TaMaAg.Get ’em, Dad!"

translation: Dawaj, tato!

source_text: Get back, you monsters!

structure.raw_value: BrMaAgNo1.Get back, you monsters!
structure.script_literal: "BrMaAgNo1.Get back, you monsters!"

translation: Cofnijcie się, potwory!

source_text: Argh! Get that thing out of my face!

structure.raw_value: MlHuAg.Argh! Get that thing out of my face!
structure.script_literal: "MlHuAg.Argh! Get that thing out of my face!"

translation: Argh! Zabierzcie mi to sprzed nosa!

source_text: Protect Mother at all costs!

structure.raw_value: HoMaAgNo1>.Protect Mother at all costs!
structure.script_literal: "HoMaAgNo1>.Protect Mother at all costs!"

translation: Chrońcie Matkę za wszelką cenę!

source_text: Kimberly!

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.Kimberly!
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.Kimberly!"

translation: Kimberly!

source_text: Get off of him, you freaks!

structure.raw_value: TaMaAg>.Get off of him, you freaks!
structure.script_literal: "TaMaAg>.Get off of him, you freaks!"

translation: Zostawcie go, potwory!

source_text: The pain! The pain!

structure.raw_value: D2HuAg.The pain! The pain!
structure.script_literal: "D2HuAg.The pain! The pain!"

translation: Boli! Jak boli!

source_text: Do not look into the crucifix.

structure.raw_value: D3WoCl>.Do not look into the crucifix.
structure.script_literal: "D3WoCl>.Do not look into the crucifix."

translation: Nie patrz na krucyfiks.

source_text: I got Kimberly! Let’s move!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I got Kimberly! Let’s move!
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I got Kimberly! Let’s move!"

translation: Mam Kimberly! Ruszamy!

source_text: That holy relic is a good weapon against demons. If they come back, I’ll use it on them.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx.That holy relic is a good weapon against demons. If they come back, I’ll use it on them.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx.That holy relic is a good weapon against demons. If they come back, I’ll use it on them."

translation: Ta święta relikwia to dobra broń przeciw demonom. Jeśli wrócą, użyję jej przeciwko nim.

source_text: Not so fast, creeps!

structure.raw_value: ElHaOp.Not so fast, creeps!
structure.script_literal: "ElHaOp.Not so fast, creeps!"

translation: Nie tak szybko, obleśniaki!

source_text: Impeccable timing, Miss Adair.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp>.Impeccable timing, Miss Adair.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp>.Impeccable timing, Miss Adair."

translation: Idealnie w czasie, panno Adair.

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. Let’s get the hell out of here!

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx.Come on, 1Hero. Let’s get the hell out of here!
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx.Come on, 1Hero. Let’s get the hell out of here!"

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Wynośmy się stąd, do cholery!

source_text: A demon!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.A demon!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.A demon!"

translation: Demon!

source_text: Who, me?

structure.raw_value: EvWoCl^.Who, me?
structure.script_literal: "EvWoCl^.Who, me?"

translation: Ja?

source_text: Should we go find Brian? He can kill these things, right?

structure.raw_value: NeWoCl.Should we go find Brian? He can kill these things, right?
structure.script_literal: "NeWoCl.Should we go find Brian? He can kill these things, right?"

translation: Powinniśmy poszukać Briana? Potrafi zabić te stwory, prawda?

source_text: Hey, fuck you!...

structure.raw_value: EvAnDe^.Hey, fuck you!...
structure.script_literal: "EvAnDe^.Hey, fuck you!..."

translation: Hej, pierdol się!...

source_text: I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but you people died and you came to Hell.

structure.raw_value: EvAnEx^.I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but you people died and you came to Hell.
structure.script_literal: "EvAnEx^.I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but you people died and you came to Hell."

translation: Nie lubię przekazywać złych wieści, ale umarliście i trafiliście do Piekła.

source_text: We’re not dead.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.We’re not dead.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.We’re not dead."

translation: Nie umarliśmy.

source_text: Listen! I’m not going to argue with you. You sucked at life, you died, and now you’re here.

structure.raw_value: EvAnEx^.Listen! I’m not going to argue with you. You sucked at life, you died, and now you’re here.
structure.script_literal: "EvAnEx^.Listen! I’m not going to argue with you. You sucked at life, you died, and now you’re here."

translation: Słuchaj! Nie będę się z tobą kłócić. Byliście beznadziejni za życia, umarliście, a teraz jesteście tutaj.

source_text: He’s telling the truth. We came through a portal.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.He’s telling the truth. We came through a portal.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.He’s telling the truth. We came through a portal."

translation: Mówi prawdę. Przeszliśmy przez portal.

source_text: Haha! What a kooky bunch. The girls are going to love you.

structure.raw_value: EvFlDe^.Haha! What a kooky bunch. The girls are going to love you.
structure.script_literal: "EvFlDe^.Haha! What a kooky bunch. The girls are going to love you."

translation: Ha, ha! Ale z was dziwna gromadka. Dziewczyny będą zachwycone.

source_text: What girls?

structure.raw_value: MeWoCl.What girls?
structure.script_literal: "MeWoCl.What girls?"

translation: Jakie dziewczyny?

source_text: The other demon girls, of course.

structure.raw_value: EvFlEx^.The other demon girls, of course.
structure.script_literal: "EvFlEx^.The other demon girls, of course."

translation: Pozostałe demony, oczywiście.

source_text: Listen here, monster. We are here for Erica. She committed blasphemy and she should be here…

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Listen here, monster. We are here for Erica. She committed blasphemy and she should be here…
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Listen here, monster. We are here for Erica. She committed blasphemy and she should be here…"

translation: Słuchaj, potworze. Szukamy Eriki. Zbluźniła i powinna tu być…

source_text: That’s the idea.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.That’s the idea.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.That’s the idea."

translation: Właśnie o to chodzi.

source_text: There are about 14 million Ericas here. Can you be more specific?

structure.raw_value: EvAnDe^.There are about 14 million Ericas here. Can you be more specific?
structure.script_literal: "EvAnDe^.There are about 14 million Ericas here. Can you be more specific?"

translation: Jest tu jakieś czternaście milionów dziewczyn o imieniu Erica. Możesz podać więcej szczegółów?

source_text: Lilith told us to meet her here at this altar.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Lilith told us to meet her here at this altar.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Lilith told us to meet her here at this altar."

translation: Lilith kazała nam spotkać się z nią tutaj, przy ołtarzu.

source_text: Lilith?... Did I come here on the wrong day?

structure.raw_value: EvWoDe^.Lilith?... Did I come here on the wrong day?
structure.script_literal: "EvWoDe^.Lilith?... Did I come here on the wrong day?"

translation: Lilith?... Czyżbym przyszła tu nie w ten dzień?

source_text: You didn’t see a dark-skinned, pretty girl with short hair?

structure.raw_value: ElBaDe.You didn’t see a dark-skinned, pretty girl with short hair?
structure.script_literal: "ElBaDe.You didn’t see a dark-skinned, pretty girl with short hair?"

translation: Nie widziałaś ładnej, ciemnoskórej dziewczyny z krótkimi włosami?

source_text: Hmm… Doesn’t ring a bell.

structure.raw_value: EvBaDe^.Hmm… Doesn’t ring a bell.
structure.script_literal: "EvBaDe^.Hmm… Doesn’t ring a bell."

translation: Hmm… Nic mi to nie mówi.

source_text: Give me a moment. I need to speak with the manager.

structure.raw_value: EvFlDe^.Give me a moment. I need to speak with the manager.
structure.script_literal: "EvFlDe^.Give me a moment. I need to speak with the manager."

translation: Daj mi chwilę. Muszę porozmawiać z kierownikiem.

source_text: Where is Erica? Are we in the right place?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Where is Erica? Are we in the right place?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Where is Erica? Are we in the right place?"

translation: Gdzie jest Erica? Na pewno jesteśmy we właściwym miejscu?

source_text: I hope Brian doesn't drag his feet. We could use his help here too.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.I hope Brian doesn't drag his feet. We could use his help here too.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.I hope Brian doesn't drag his feet. We could use his help here too."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Brian się nie ociąga. Tutaj też przydałaby nam się jego pomoc.

source_text: Be on the lookout. Demons could show up at any moment.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Be on the lookout. Demons could show up at any moment.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Be on the lookout. Demons could show up at any moment."

translation: Miejcie się na baczności. Demony mogą pojawić się w każdej chwili.

source_text: If any more demons show up, I’ll cut their heads off!

structure.raw_value: ElAnAg.If any more demons show up, I’ll cut their heads off!
structure.script_literal: "ElAnAg.If any more demons show up, I’ll cut their heads off!"

translation: Jeśli pojawią się kolejne demony, odrąbię im głowy!

source_text: Do you think the priest will find the Toma?

structure.raw_value: AdWoDe.Do you think the priest will find the Toma?
structure.script_literal: "AdWoDe.Do you think the priest will find the Toma?"

translation: Myślisz, że ksiądz znajdzie Tomę?

source_text: Any sign of Erica?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Any sign of Erica?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Any sign of Erica?"

translation: Jakieś wieści o Erice?

source_text: Are we sure we’re in the right place?

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.Are we sure we’re in the right place?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.Are we sure we’re in the right place?"

translation: Na pewno jesteśmy we właściwym miejscu?

source_text: How would we know?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.How would we know?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.How would we know?"

translation: Skąd mielibyśmy wiedzieć?

source_text: Erica! Are you okay?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Erica! Are you okay?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Erica! Are you okay?"

translation: Erica! Wszystko w porządku?

source_text: Seems we’ve scared off those demons.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx^.Seems we’ve scared off those demons.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx^.Seems we’ve scared off those demons."

translation: Wygląda na to, że przepędziliśmy te demony.

source_text: Almost a shame.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.Almost a shame.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.Almost a shame."

translation: Prawie szkoda.

source_text: Where is Lillian? What’s taking her so long?

structure.raw_value: MeWoCl^.Where is Lillian? What’s taking her so long?
structure.script_literal: "MeWoCl^.Where is Lillian? What’s taking her so long?"

translation: Gdzie jest Lillian? Czemu tak długo jej nie ma?

source_text: The angel was right… I guess this is real.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.The angel was right… I guess this is real.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.The angel was right… I guess this is real."

translation: Anioł miał rację… Chyba to wszystko dzieje się naprawdę.

source_text: I’m sorry, Erica.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.I’m sorry, Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.I’m sorry, Erica."

translation: Przykro mi, Erico.

source_text: What’s all that noise?

structure.raw_value: TaWoOp.What’s all that noise?
structure.script_literal: "TaWoOp.What’s all that noise?"

translation: Co to za hałas?

source_text: Everything okay?

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe^.Everything okay?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe^.Everything okay?"

translation: Wszystko w porządku?

source_text: Everything’s fine. We just need Lillian to show up.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Everything’s fine. We just need Lillian to show up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Everything’s fine. We just need Lillian to show up."

translation: Wszystko dobrze. Czekamy tylko, aż pojawi się Lillian.

source_text: You found Erica!

structure.raw_value: TaHaAg.You found Erica!
structure.script_literal: "TaHaAg.You found Erica!"

translation: Znaleźliście Ericę!

source_text: How many of you guys are looking for me?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.How many of you guys are looking for me?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.How many of you guys are looking for me?"

translation: Ilu was mnie szuka?

source_text: Uhh... Where are your...?

structure.raw_value: BoWoEx^.Uhh... Where are your...?
structure.script_literal: "BoWoEx^.Uhh... Where are your...?"

translation: Eee… Gdzie są twoje…?

source_text: We’ve got a big party down here.

structure.raw_value: TaBaEx.We’ve got a big party down here.
structure.script_literal: "TaBaEx.We’ve got a big party down here."

translation: Na dole trwa wielka impreza.

source_text: Brian and the treasure hunters are looking for the Toma Leolo. We think it’s here in Hell.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Brian and the treasure hunters are looking for the Toma Leolo. We think it’s here in Hell.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Brian and the treasure hunters are looking for the Toma Leolo. We think it’s here in Hell."

translation: Brian i łowcy skarbów szukają Tomy Leolo. Sądzimy, że jest tutaj, w Piekle.

source_text: Lillian has your body… We’re just waiting on it.

structure.raw_value: NeFrEx^.Lillian has your body… We’re just waiting on it.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrEx^.Lillian has your body… We’re just waiting on it."

translation: Lillian ma twoje ciało… Czekamy, aż je przyniesie.

source_text: We trust her?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.We trust her?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.We trust her?"

translation: Mamy jej zaufać?

source_text: Erica… She’s in battle against another demon…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Erica… She’s in battle against another demon…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Erica… She’s in battle against another demon…"

translation: Erica… Walczy z innym demonem…

source_text: A demon that took your body.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.A demon that took your body.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.A demon that took your body."

translation: Z demonem, który zabrał twoje ciało.

source_text: Don’t worry. You didn’t commit blasphemy in vain. We’ll get your body back.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx^.Don’t worry. You didn’t commit blasphemy in vain. We’ll get your body back.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx^.Don’t worry. You didn’t commit blasphemy in vain. We’ll get your body back."

translation: Nie martw się. Nie zbluźniłaś na próżno. Odzyskamy twoje ciało.

source_text: We need to trust Lillian. She’ll do the right thing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We need to trust Lillian. She’ll do the right thing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We need to trust Lillian. She’ll do the right thing."

translation: Musimy zaufać Lillian. Postąpi właściwie.

source_text: That’s a lot of faith put into a demon.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.That’s a lot of faith put into a demon.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.That’s a lot of faith put into a demon."

translation: Pokładacie w tym demonie naprawdę wielką wiarę.

source_text: I know she wants to save Erica… She cares about her.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I know she wants to save Erica… She cares about her.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I know she wants to save Erica… She cares about her."

translation: Wiem, że chce uratować Ericę… Zależy jej na niej.

source_text: If you trust her, then I will too.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.If you trust her, then I will too.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.If you trust her, then I will too."

translation: Skoro jej ufasz, ja też jej zaufam.

source_text: I’m going to send my men back into the mansion…

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx^.I’m going to send my men back into the mansion…
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx^.I’m going to send my men back into the mansion…"

translation: Wyślę moich ludzi z powrotem do rezydencji…

source_text: We need to know if it’s safe to return.

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe^.We need to know if it’s safe to return.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe^.We need to know if it’s safe to return."

translation: Musimy wiedzieć, czy można tam bezpiecznie wrócić.

source_text: That could be a deathtrap.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.That could be a deathtrap.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.That could be a deathtrap."

translation: To może być śmiertelna pułapka.

source_text: We know… But what else can we do?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe^.We know… But what else can we do?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe^.We know… But what else can we do?"

translation: Wiemy… Ale co innego możemy zrobić?

source_text: He’s right. If things go south, we need to know how to escape.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.He’s right. If things go south, we need to know how to escape.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.He’s right. If things go south, we need to know how to escape."

translation: Ma rację. Jeśli sprawy przybiorą zły obrót, musimy wiedzieć, którędy uciec.

source_text: Can Erica leave without her body?

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe^.Can Erica leave without her body?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe^.Can Erica leave without her body?"

translation: Czy Erica może odejść bez swojego ciała?

source_text: No… Trust me on that one. It’s not simple, getting in and out of the rift.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.No… Trust me on that one. It’s not simple, getting in and out of the rift.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.No… Trust me on that one. It’s not simple, getting in and out of the rift."

translation: Nie… Zaufaj mi. Przechodzenie przez szczelinę w obie strony nie jest takie proste.

source_text: No sign of him.

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx^.No sign of him.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx^.No sign of him."

translation: Nie ma po nim śladu.

source_text: I’ll check on Father Solomon. Wait here for Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ll check on Father Solomon. Wait here for Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ll check on Father Solomon. Wait here for Lillian."

translation: Sprawdzę, co z ojcem Solomonem. Poczekajcie tu na Lillian.

source_text: Yeah… They can’t stand the holy relic.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.Yeah… They can’t stand the holy relic.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.Yeah… They can’t stand the holy relic."

translation: Tak… Nie znoszą świętej relikwii.

source_text: Hurry back, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Hurry back, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Hurry back, 1Hero."

translation: Wracaj szybko, 1Hero.

source_text: This ground looks weak. I wonder what would happen if I hit it with a pickaxe.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.This ground looks weak. I wonder what would happen if I hit it with a pickaxe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.This ground looks weak. I wonder what would happen if I hit it with a pickaxe."

translation: Ten grunt wygląda na kruchy. Ciekawe, co by się stało, gdybym uderzył w niego kilofem.

source_text: Look around, 1Hero. I’m sure you can find what you're looking for.

structure.raw_value: EvFlDe.Look around, 1Hero. I’m sure you can find what you're looking for.
structure.script_literal: "EvFlDe.Look around, 1Hero. I’m sure you can find what you're looking for."

translation: Rozejrzyj się, 1Hero. Na pewno znajdziesz to, czego szukasz.

source_text: Erica!?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Erica!?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Erica!?"

translation: Eriko!?

source_text: What’s the deal, Father?

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp.What’s the deal, Father?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaOp.What’s the deal, Father?"

translation: O co chodzi, ojcze?

source_text: We don’t know how to get her back into her body.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx^.We don’t know how to get her back into her body.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx^.We don’t know how to get her back into her body."

translation: Nie wiemy, jak przywrócić ją do jej ciała.

source_text: I have no idea what I’m doing.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.I have no idea what I’m doing.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.I have no idea what I’m doing."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, co robię.

source_text: Do we need to say a prayer?

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx^.Do we need to say a prayer?
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx^.Do we need to say a prayer?"

translation: Musimy się pomodlić?

source_text: I don’t think that’ll do it.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe^.I don’t think that’ll do it.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe^.I don’t think that’ll do it."

translation: Chyba to nie wystarczy.

source_text: What is Lillian’s plan? Is she bringing the Toma to us?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What is Lillian’s plan? Is she bringing the Toma to us?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What is Lillian’s plan? Is she bringing the Toma to us?"

translation: Jaki jest plan Lillian? Przyniesie nam Tomę?

source_text: Shit… We need some help.

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp.Shit… We need some help.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnOp.Shit… We need some help."

translation: Cholera… Potrzebujemy pomocy.

source_text: Evie!

structure.raw_value: HrShCl.Evie!
structure.script_literal: "HrShCl.Evie!"

translation: Evie!

source_text: Henry, there you are!

structure.raw_value: EvHaOp^.Henry, there you are!
structure.script_literal: "EvHaOp^.Henry, there you are!"

translation: Henry, nareszcie jesteś!

source_text: What are you doing here?... And what are you holding?

structure.raw_value: HrWoCl.What are you doing here?... And what are you holding?
structure.script_literal: "HrWoCl.What are you doing here?... And what are you holding?"

translation: Co ty tu robisz?... I co trzymasz?
